questions.question: What does David call God in Psalm 16?
options: His fortress and his high tower
His chosen portion and his cup
questions.answer: His chosen portion and his cup

questions.question: What confidence does David express about death?
options: Death is the very final end of all the living, both the great and the small
He alone of all the men on earth will never once taste death at all
God will not abandon his soul to Sheol or let his holy one see corruption
The grave will hold him fast and firm until the whole world is renewed
questions.answer: God will not abandon his soul to Sheol or let his holy one see corruption

questions.question: David says he has set the LORD always before him; he shall not be shaken.
Preserve me, O God, for in you I take _____.
You make known to me the path of life; in your presence is fullness of _____.
